items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: played a few numbers with him

ctx.x: Peter Clayton. Oh. Peter Clayton Club over the past. And Cap, he just preached himself. And he went on out there and, uh, played a few numbers with him and he come on back home. But he, uh, his wife said he didn't feel like going. But he never did, he never did.
He didn't want to turn him down. Turned anybody down.
